proves: a z-index:-1 child of a parent that establishes no stacking context is hoisted to the nearest ancestor that does, and paints before that ancestor's background - so its own parent's background covers it.
checkable: 200x72, three 56x56 red cells at y=8..63, each holding a 36x36 blue child at z-index -1 inset 10,10. Read the child's column at three rows rather than one, y=20, 35 and 50, so a child painted in part rather than not at all is a different reading from a child hidden: cell 0 at x=35 and cell 1 at x=99 read 220,40,40 at all three - hoisted, and covered by the parent's red. Cell 2 at x=163 reads 42,82,220 at all three - its parent's 0.99 opacity establishes a context, so its child stays and paints above the background. The parents' own red reads 220,40,40 at x=12 and 220,42,42 at x=140, the second being that same opacity.
expected: cell 0 is a plain parent and cell 1 clips with overflow:hidden. Neither establishes a stacking context, so the child belongs to the grandparent and paints before the parent's background - Chrome hides it in both, measured with elementFromPoint. Cell 2's parent has opacity 0.99, which does establish one, so its child belongs to it and paints above its background: that cell is correct today and is the control.
why_three: two cells flipping while one holds says the fix was the hoist rather than a change of sign. A fixture with only the two defective cells would pass if the painter started hiding every negative child.
clipping: cell 1 also guards a property this renderer has by construction: enter_node clips with clip_to_box rather than opening a layer, so overflow:hidden creates no context. It is the trigger most often assumed to create one. A change that reaches for save_layer to clip would establish a context the Chrome measurement says must not exist, and this cell's picture would move.
status: measured from the committed image, and against Chrome. This pinned a defect when it was written and the painter was fixed in the commit that added the image (981fa39), so the numbers here are the fixed behaviour and the fixture now guards it. Cells 0 and 1 turning blue again is the regression it exists to catch.
